summary: Camp4 Therapeutics filed an 8-K regarding an amendment to its September 2025 securities purchase agreement, triggered by achieving a clinical trial milestone and price threshold waiver. The original private placement involved up to 65.4 million shares at $1.53 per share with pre-funded warrants, raising ~$50.1 million at initial closing. The amendment, dated August 3, 2026, adjusts terms with certain accredited investors. No new pricing or consideration is disclosed in the excerpt. The transaction is a follow-on equity financing, not a traditional special situation; watch for further disclosure of amended terms and any additional closings.
